stem: How do the story from A Forest Full of Stars and the article "More Than Air" use the idea of imagination DIFFERENTLY?

options.label: A
options.text: In the story Rachel sees imagination as a fun game, but in the article imagination is seen as important for work.

options.label: B
options.text: In the story imagination helps Rachel feel close to family, but in the article people express what they imagine through carvings.

options.label: C
options.text: In the story Rachel is uncertain about how to use imagination, but in the article people are sure that imagination will be good for them.

options.label: D
options.text: In the story imagination is difficult for Rachel to use, but in the article artists use imagination easily.
